instructions_to_main_agent: Follow RTL Hebrew-first structure strictly: `dir="rtl"` on root container, text aligned to right, icons appropriately mirrored where directional.

Implement the kinetic before-and-after doll story in the hero section: provide an interactive draggable/scrubbable split slider comparing the raw white 3D printed figurine with the fully painted, vibrant masterpiece.

Ensure all shop categories, doll products, and the customized superhero experience have robust mock data, realistic pricing in ₪ (ILS), paint difficulty levels (קל / בינוני / מתקדם), dimensions, and bundled paint options.

Build a complete multi-step Superhero Photo Customizer with photo upload simulation, live preview state with 3D turn/color toggles, child's name customization, and direct add-to-cart with personalized specifications.

Provide a sleek slide-over cart drawer and complete checkout flow with local Israeli delivery options (שליח עד הבית 3-5 ימי עסקים, איסוף עצמי מסטודיו תל אביב), promo code support, and order confirmation receipt.

Implement all informative pages: About (סיפור המותג והטכנולוגיה), FAQ (שאלות נפוצות על צבעי אקריליק ובטיחות), Contact (טופס יצירת קשר ו-WhatsApp), Shipping & Returns (משלוחים והחזרות), Privacy Policy (מדיניות פרטיות ומחיקת תמונות), and Terms (תנאי שימוש).
Ensure generous padding and crisp earthy design aesthetic (cream #FAF7F2, terracotta #C85A32, deep clay #2C221E) with subtle borders and 0 generic bootstrap layout feel.
Include `data-testid` attributes on all buttons, links, inputs, selectors, and interactive cards for automated testing.
